instructions: Fresh review of each primary candidate: read dialogue first, then exact cards. Assess all six unchanged criteria and all coach-2.0 gates with turn-specific evidence. For pairs, show whether the Stance changes HOW A pursues the Drive in one interaction. Do not invent missing backstory or assume prior approval. Use the alternate only to assess meaningful differentiation. Report actual reservations. No writer scores or improvement claims are supplied.
productionStandard:
PRODUCTION STANDARD coach-2.0. Historical coach-1.0 acceptance is not coach-2.0 acceptance. Read the dialogue first and record what the spoken words establish before interpreting the card. Exact cards are already in this invocation: label internal-dialogue-first, never blind or human review. Do not invent a charitable backstory; harmless unspecified names/history are not defects. Fill coach2 for ORIGINAL dialogue in writer output and CANDIDATE dialogue in reviewer output. Copy the supplied dialogue hash for the text being assessed. Give concise actual turn evidence, not generic claims.
G1: legible immediate situation, wants/stakes; separate stated, ordinary inferred, and missing essentials. Identify first material defect or explicitly none.
G2: coherent facts, ownership, timing, language, knowledge; recognizable misunderstanding/revelation is allowed, unstated intervening events are not.
G3: assess all A1-B2, B2-A3, A3-B4, B4-A5 links. Vocabulary repetition alone is insufficient. Purposeful avoidance must read as behavior.
G4: B is a plausible participant with an intelligible practical/emotional position, not a contrived punchline cue. B can help, concede or solve.
G5: exact card changes A's choices. For pairs Stance changes HOW A pursues Drive and B responds to the merged behavior; neither card may be decorative.
G6: ending develops the same behavior using B4. Investigate if A5 would work after unrelated B4; more obstacles are not required for heightening.
format: five spoken ABABA turns, existing word/schema limit, no narration/coaching/truncation.
Every mandatory gate and transition is PASS, FAIL or UNCLEAR with evidence; UNCLEAR cannot be accepted. All gates pass AND total >=85 AND fidelity/response >=4 AND others >=3; preserve the six weights 30/20/15/15/10/10. A 5 is not merely presence. Totals are derived in code. Retain good originals; no rewrite quota. Review both alternatives for different tactics, relationships or pressure. Scene outline identifies roles, task, A want, B want, stakes, exact-card tactic and B's contribution; it is private planning evidence, not a substitute for missing spoken facts. Humour must come from sincere priorities and responsive choices, not stock hierarchy or unrelated slogans. Record actual weaknesses and reservations. Writer corrections target only rejected/materially changed scenes; preserve all accepted records and prior original assessments exactly. No coach-1.0 failure or exhausted allowance is erased by this separately versioned cycle.

cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: More Official Than You
cards.instruction: Turn every suggestion into a contest over whose method, title, precedent, or paperwork is more legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Your picnic rota is useful. Mine has committee approval.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine got everyone to bring sandwiches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Mine establishes who was entitled to request those sandwiches.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then approve mine. We've already started eating.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Gladly. I'll attach it as an appendix to mine, so lunch has a legitimate basis.

cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: A Valuable Safeguard
cards.instruction: Treat every delay, restriction, and extra step as evidence that the system is becoming safer and more thorough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They've added a fourth inspection to our climbing wall. Leave the booking calendar closed; I welcome that extra safeguard.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Opening is delayed another month. Shall I ask them to combine two inspections?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. A whole month without an uninspected climb is worth keeping separate. You can tell the customers I support the delay.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We'll lose the season. They'll want their bookings refunded.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Arrange the refunds under my name. Nobody will be tempted to use a booking before we're ready. Every cancelled climb is another risk the system has kept off our wall.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our school trip needs two signatures on every consent form. Keep the children here until I see both; a second check is reassuring.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm the only teacher here. Could I check twice instead of waiting for June?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may check again, but it won't replace her signature. Independent eyes are worth the wait.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: June wrote the forms. She says someone else should check her work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: She's right. Keep her as the author and find a third person to check. I'll hold departure while you do. We have discovered the safeguard our second safeguard needed.

cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Warmly Enforced
cards.instruction: Remain kind and welcoming while enforcing increasingly restrictive rules without exception.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're delighted you're staying. I'll put you in our lovely guest room; just no food upstairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Of course. I'll have breakfast downstairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. I'll see you in the kitchen after nine; we keep it quiet before then.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My train's at eight. Could I take a banana?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd love you to have one. Breakfast food stays in the kitchen, though; I can't make an exception even for a favorite guest. Stay for the later train and I'll choose you our nicest banana.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Welcome to the swimming club! I'm delighted to have you. I'll arrange your first swim once you've completed induction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Lovely. Can I join today's induction?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd be pleased to put you on the next one after you've observed today. I'll save you a place in the gallery.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The gallery's closed. Could I watch from the poolside?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd love to have you beside us, but I can't waive the induction rule for poolside access. Let me choose you a brochure with a lovely view; you can sit with me at reception.

cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: There Is a Process
cards.instruction: Treat every favor, feeling, and urgent need as a request requiring terms, documentation, review, and approval.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before I reassure you about the wedding, what precisely am I guaranteeing?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That it'll be okay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Weather, marriage, or catering? They have different approval routes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I just need a hug.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One-time or renewable reassurance? I'll amend the request.

beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I'd love to lend you my umbrella. How long is the proposed loan?

cards.title: Exactly Within Policy
cards.instruction: Agree to every request only after interpreting the policy so it grants you authority, protection, or an exemption.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Yes, I'll clean the hall. The policy lets senior volunteers supervise.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm asking you to mop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Exactly. Supervising the mop is covered.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who will hold it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Someone whose contribution isn't restricted by seniority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, I'll host Christmas under our shared-effort rule. I'll decide the seating; you can bring me the cooking list.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: So what will you cook?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The rule counts hosting as effort. I accept that as my share; you may divide the cooking between the remaining names.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There are only two names. Yours and mine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then put the dinner beside yours and the hosting beside mine. Equal columns. I'll choose a table where we can both see how fairly we've applied the rule.
